## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      4 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 10, 2026 - Sep 22, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Christopher Peterson_, Sep 22, 2026, 1/5: "New App now has functionality issues the old version did not. The check-ins counter was previously a great way for me to track my annual progress and keep pace with previous years. I had completed 162 check-ins for this year prior to the update. Now it just reads 99 and no additional check-ins seem to be logged. An accurate counter seems like the easiest thing to program into an app and somehow the developers really screwed this one up. Please fix! and bring back my accurate checkin count!"
            2. _Phoenix Fire Guy_, Sep 21, 2026, 1/5: "The updated app sucks. Entirely too complicated and bloated with worthless information and pictures. Accessing the guest pass is burdensome, loads terribly slow. You took a good working app and absolutely ruined it. I recommend terminating anyone involved with the updated app."
            3. _AJey Calloway_, Jul 18, 2026, 1/5: "I'm completely over this app. I joined Planet Fitness 2 weeks ago and still have not been able to get this app to work. I tried logging in half a dozen times and it freezes. I've only been able to successfully login 1 time and even then it never gave to QR code so that I can scan everytime I enter Planet Fitness. I'm sooo over this and it's just frustrating. Even the team members that work there couldn't figure out why this is happening."
<!--/ir-theme-->
